text: 吴起替魏国守住西河，功劳连魏国的前一任宰相都承认不如他。可一门婚事，却让他在魏国待不下去。
Wu Qi held Wei's western frontier at Xihe, and even Wei's previous chief minister admitted that his record was the greater. Yet a single marriage offer left him unable to stay in Wei.
在楚国，楚悼王早就听说他贤能，让吴起做了宰相。吴起严明法令，裁掉不急需的官员，罢免与王室血缘疏远的公族，集中力量强兵，楚国强盛起来，各国都忧虑楚国的强大。史书写道，因此楚国的贵戚都想害他。悼王一死，王族大臣作乱，攻击吴起；吴起跑到悼王遗体处，伏在遗体上，攻击他的人又射又刺吴起，也击中了悼王的遗体。悼王下葬、太子即位后，下令把射吴起时也射中了王尸的人全部处死，因此被灭族的有七十多家。

In Chu, King Dao, who had long heard of his ability, made Wu Qi chief minister. Wu Qi made the laws clear and strict, cut offices that were not needed, dismissed royal kinsmen of distant blood, and put the state's strength into its army; Chu grew strong, and the other states feared its power. For this reason, the history says, Chu's nobles all wanted him dead. When King Dao died, members of the royal clan rose up and attacked Wu Qi. He ran to the king's body and threw himself on it; his attackers shot and stabbed him, and struck the king's body too. After King Dao was buried and the crown prince came to the throne, the new king had everyone who had shot at Wu Qi and also struck the king's body put to death, and more than seventy families were wiped out for it.
